verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never describes bulk or batch record imports, throughput at millions of records, or asynchronous task IDs and status polling to confirm when indexing completes. The closest items are a generic statement that the Search API can 'manage your indices and records' and dashboard-scheduled connector syncs with retries, which are adjacent rather than this capability. Community mentions of a 1.5M-record index or a simple node import script do not document bulk-import speed or task tracking.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can bulk-import millions of documents quickly, with async task tracking to know when indexing completes
